{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Black wool-blend sheath dress with a subtle A-line silhouette falling to the knee, charcoal #4A4E55.  
Cashmere slip blouse in soft cream #F5F1EB layered under the neckline for depth.  
Silver-toned hoop earrings in polished metal #C0C0C0 and a thin gold chain necklace #FFD700.  
Leather pointed-toe pumps in classic black #2B2B2B with a moderate 7 cm heel.  

This outfit respects her request for restrained and classical tones while perfectly fitting the evening theatre setting at 19:00. The structured sheath dress combined with the refined cashmere layering creates an elegant silhouette that balances professionalism with warmth for autumn weather. Accessory choices in neutral metals complement her cool-toned hair without overpowering the classic aesthetic, ensuring a cohesive and timeless look suitable for the occasion."}
